correctness.rationale: For any compactly supported positive stationary probability, smooth log-coordinate generator identities fix three means and reciprocal height. A weighted square gives nonnegative and strict height excess. Exact L(x-y+z)=2d-2bxy and Lx=Ly=0 lock all three pair products. Subtract products of means for all three negative covariances. Equality r=1 forces constant z then a linear x–y relation and zero x–y covariance, hence constant x,y and the unique equilibrium. Symbolic checker verifies foundational exact identities.

value.rationale: For a genuinely minimal four-reaction three-species network exhibiting an exceptional vertical Hopf continuum, quantifying the effect of recurrent oscillations on concentration levels and reaction throughputs is mathematically motivated. The theorem gives a complete rate-independent three-pair anticorrelation law and resolves the apparent tension between increased mean concentrations and unchanged pair reaction-flux averages, with an exact nonnegative variance-like defect. It applies to every compact positive stationary law, beyond the already known periodic center manifold; this is substantive invariant-measure structure, not an isolated normalization exercise.
